unmet_need_hypothesis: Windows Store developers and small sellers may need a local preflight of image dimensions, orientation, format, file size and listing compliance with actionable fix explanations, without uploading assets. This is narrower than generic photo management, but existing free image tools can inspect dimensions.
offline_local_only_advantage: Preflight unpublished promotional images without cloud upload, no edits/deletes, CSV for collaborators; this alone is not unique because XnView and Czkawka work locally.
buyer_persona: Solo Microsoft Store app developer preparing bilingual product listings or small business content operator; unvalidated.
store_search_keywords: 画像サイズ チェック
why_pay_statement: NOT YET PROVEN: a dedicated Microsoft Store listing-image preflight report might save submission rework, but current header-only inventory does not provide it.

price_hypothesis.redesigned_candidate: JPY 500–1000 one-time after validated Store-asset preflight workflow

proposed_redefinition.name: Local Store Image Preflight Desk
differentiators: Explicit current Microsoft Store MSIX desktop screenshot profile: PNG, >=1366x768, <=50MB, orientation and actionable per-file PASS/FAIL
Batch report for multiple listing languages, missing/wrong-size assets and safe no-edit review; future profiles versioned with citation and date
constraints: No claim that dimensions alone guarantee Store approval
No image editing or EXIF/full-pixel validation without separate dependencies/tests
Do not duplicate Windows-checker's package certification; image-only consumer workflow
Official profile must be maintained and tested against changing Microsoft documentation
Protect against decompression bombs and malformed headers
needs_validation: Verify current screenshot and logo requirements by package family
Windows 1024x768 UI and large-image failure QA

gate_policy: <70: Store work forbidden; 70-79 redesign; >=80 candidate only if all GO conditions met
current_feature_evidence: README: PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP header inventory, 200-file cap, dimensions/byte count, CSV, no thumbnails/EXIF/resizing. Does not currently implement official Store listing compliance.
